beats.label: S1 · Medellín rises
beats.text: Smuggler Pablo Escobar partners with Gustavo, the Ochoas and Gacha to move Chilean-recipe cocaine into Miami, and the Medellín Cartel becomes so rich Pablo buries the cash in his fields.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the empire and the alliances that every later conflict is measured against.

beats.label: S1 · Murphy and Peña arrive
beats.text: DEA agents Steve Murphy and Javier Peña set up in Bogotá to hunt Pablo, and a dead cat strung up in Murphy's apartment tells them the cartel already knows their names.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the two-man POV of the whole hunt and the personal stakes of being on Pablo's list.

beats.label: S1 · Politician to fugitive
beats.text: Pablo bribes his way into Congress with journalist and mistress Valeria Velez smoothing the ground, but Justice Minister Lara Bonilla exposes him; humiliated, he resigns and has Lara assassinated.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pivot that turns Pablo from would-be statesman into an enemy of the state and unlocks extradition.

beats.label: S1 · Palace of Justice
beats.text: Facing extradition, Pablo pays M-19 guerrilla Ivan two million dollars to storm the Palace of Justice and burn the evidence against him, then quietly kills Ivan once the job is done.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Pablo will incinerate a branch of government to protect himself, and sets the ruthlessness that defines the rest of the war.

beats.label: S1 · Colonel Carrillo's Search Bloc
beats.text: Peña and Murphy bribe a general to install Colonel Carrillo at the head of Search Bloc, giving the hunt for Pablo a soldier willing to match him execution for execution.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the government's attack dog and the doctrine of extrajudicial force that will define the campaign.

beats.label: S1 · Gacha down, Avianca up
beats.text: Carrillo and Peña corner and kill Gacha and his son, and Pablo answers by tricking a young man into carrying a bomb onto Avianca 203 in a failed attempt to murder candidate Gaviria.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First cartel head falls and Pablo escalates to civilian mass murder — the war is now total.

beats.label: S1 · La Catedral
beats.text: Cornered, Pablo cuts a deal to surrender to a prison he built himself, La Catedral, but his brazen operations from inside push the government toward storming it — and the Cali Cartel and the DEA are already moving on him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the exact situation the next season opens on: Pablo about to bolt from a fake prison with new enemies closing.

cliffhanger.text: Pablo's stage-managed surrender at La Catedral has collapsed into a standoff: the government is moving to take the prison by force while Murphy, Peña and a newly-assertive Cali Cartel all wait for him to run.
questions: Can Pablo escape La Catedral before the army closes in?
How far will the Cali Cartel go now that they have decided Pablo is finished?
Will Search Bloc, the DEA and Cali end up hunting Pablo together or against each other?

characters.name: Pablo Escobar
characters.line: Head of the Medellín Cartel; failed politician turned terrorist, now cornered inside the luxury prison he built for himself.

characters.name: Steve Murphy
characters.line: DEA agent in Bogotá and the show's narrator; radicalised by threats to his family into treating the hunt as personal.

characters.name: Javier Peña
characters.line: Murphy's DEA partner, the operator of the pair; runs the informants and does the deal-making that keeps Search Bloc pointed at Pablo.

characters.name: Colonel Horacio Carrillo
characters.line: Commander of the Search Bloc, installed with DEA backing; matches cartel violence with executions of his own.

characters.name: Tata Escobar
characters.line: Pablo's wife and mother of his daughter; loyal, aware of Valeria, and holding the family together as the walls close in.

characters.name: Valeria Velez
characters.line: Journalist and Pablo's mistress; his propaganda channel and the mouthpiece he uses when he wants the country to hear him.

characters.name: Gustavo Gaviria
characters.line: Pablo's cousin and the cartel's operational brain; the one partner Pablo still fully trusts as Medellín shrinks around them.

characters.name: The Ochoa Brothers
characters.line: Aristocratic Medellín partners who built the cartel with Pablo; increasingly wary of his war with the state.

characters.name: César Gaviria
characters.line: Pro-extradition presidential candidate who survived Pablo's Avianca bomb; now the president who has to decide how to end La Catedral.
